The '''Shorn Stabilizer''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] and owned by [[Aarrom]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was known as the best neutral drinking-hole in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], a place where opposing factions could safely meet.
